note: Hand decisions for shared row ids where at least one row has no Wikidata item (region groups, themes, an article with no item). Key: <timeline A>|<timeline B>|<row id>. `same`: one thing across the two timelines; `namesake`: the id is shared but the extent or the thing differs. Reviewed by the Architect in the R4 PR; an entry goes stale when both rows gain a Wikidata id or the id stops being shared (scripts/row-identity.ts --check).
